notes: Created comprehensive BDD implementation plan for mobile bottom sheet redesign based on change request 2026-07-24-01-mobile-bottom-sheet-redesign.md. Plan covers 3 phases: (1) Core bottom sheet with tabbed navigation, hamburger toggle, backdrop/Escape dismissal — 12 unit tests, 14 E2E tests, 12 CSS validation tests; (2) Polish with swipe-to-dismiss, focus trapping, reduced motion — 3 unit tests, 3 E2E tests; (3) Migration deprecating old sidebar state. Consulted @world-review for UX perspective (body scroll lock, dvh units, focus management, virtual keyboard interference) and @planner for technical design (CSS conditional rendering, new methods vs repurposed, backdrop reuse, z-index stack). Plan includes Given-When-Then scenarios at all three levels (user behavior, component behavior, pure function behavior), specific file paths with line numbers, and measurable success criteria.
